digest.component_or_area: llm config gate read-root/session domain extraction
propositions: config.py is at 793 LOC against an 800-line cap with only seven lines of headroom, blocking new knob work like the REBAR_LLM_MODEL deprecation alias.

The gate read-root/snapshot-session domain (ContextVars and functions such as current_code_root, gate_session, assert_gated) is inert cold mass that should be extracted into a new gate_context.py module to create headroom.
Moved names must be re-exported from llm.config so no src consumer repoints, preserving the 13 function-level monkeypatch targets that resolve symbols in config's globals at call time.

ADR 0056's declarative field-table prescription for config.py does not hold because gen_env_registry.py only recognizes reads whose env name is a string literal, so a spec-row table would drop 19 rows from docs/env-vars.md and fail the CI drift gate.
assert_gated's hardcoded logger name rebar.llm.config must be re-pointed to the module actually containing the code after the move, since it emits an audited security-relevant override warning.

The shared-bound seam test loop covering config.py and workflow_ops.py must be split into per-file bounds so tightening config.py's cap to <700 does not falsely fail on the sibling file still at the staged cap.
